title: Greek Lentil Stifado
description: A hearty, comforting Greek stew made with lentils and stifado sauce, perfect for a cold winter's night.
instructions: Heat buttery oil in a large pot over medium heat.
Add chopped onion, carrot, and celery and cook until the vegetables are tender.
Add dissolved tomato paste and cook for 1 minute.
Add stifado sauce and umami broth, and bring to a boil.
Add lentils and reduce heat to low.
Simmer for 30 minutes or until the lentils are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
